Variants.Content: How the Great Wall and beyond view outsiders often says more about its character than official etiquette. Southerners often referred to those outside the Wall as savages, while free folk viewed the South's kneeling allegiance as an incomprehensible bondage; trade routes, marriage alliances, and wars would continue to force these judgment changes.
